titre.en: skills i'm glad i started at 14

legendes.en:
ur teenage years aren't only for grades. they're the cheapest time to get good at things.

none of these need talent. they need a little time every day, and starting before anyone expects u to.

u'll thank ur younger self for it.

save this and start one this week.

#selfimprovement #learning #teenagers #studytok #personaldevelopment

en.titre:
skills i'm glad i
started at 14

paragraphes: it sounds boring until u realize how much of ur life is spent typing. essays, emails, notes, applications.
i learned with free typing games for 15 minutes a day. now i write as fast as i think, and every assignment takes half the time.
not fancy food. just pasta, eggs, rice, soup, something with vegetables.
knowing how to feed urself makes u way more independent. u save money, u eat better, and u're never stuck waiting for someone else to make dinner.
i was bad at it for a long time. that was the whole point.
learning an instrument teaches u to practice something boring every day until it suddenly isn't. that skill carries into literally everything else.
Sophia gives me one lesson a day, written by actual professors, with a little quiz after. history, philosophy, science, geopolitics, literature, economics.
it's 10 minutes. but 10 minutes every day since 14 adds up to knowing a lot about how the world actually works.
ideas, plans, what i spent, what i'm worried about. if it stays in my head, it gets messy.
writing it down makes it smaller and clearer. most of my best decisions started as a messy page in a notebook.
no music, no phone, no scrolling. just a walk, a window, or a quiet room.
it felt weird at first. now it's where i actually figure out what i think, instead of borrowing everyone else's opinions.

en.texte: u don't have to monetize every skill. u just have to start one before u feel ready. future u is counting on it.
en.gras: OR.. u'll be 18 wishing u had.
